SMALL MODEL. USEFUL HABIT.

Behind the shelf.

Meaning, without a middleman.

ReplyShelf turns each saved question and your new question into a 384-number representation. The closest meanings rise to the top. The reply itself is always your exact saved text.

  1. Keep an answer you have reviewed.
  2. Search using different words.
  3. Review, copy, and make it personal.

Open by design.

AI runs in a browser worker using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (Apache-2.0) and Transformers.js (Apache-2.0). No API key, paid inference service, or AI account required.

Model and runtime files download from Hugging Face and jsDelivr. Fonts load from Google Fonts. These hosts receive normal download metadata. Questions and saved answers are not sent to an AI service. Internet is needed initially; cache availability varies. This is not a guaranteed offline app.

Know the edges.

English works best. Similarity is a ranking signal, not a probability of correctness. Below 0.42, the app withholds a ready-to-copy reply. A gap below 0.06 flags ambiguity. These are hand-set heuristics, not validated safety guarantees. Always review the full answer, dates, and policy.

Shelf data lives in this browser’s local storage, without app-level encryption or cross-device sync. Browser clearing removes it. Export a backup; don’t keep secrets here.
